project_type: MERN full-stack: React+Vite+Tailwind frontend, Node/Express/MongoDB backend
language: JavaScript (ESM throughout — both client and server use `"type": "module"`)
build_system: Root package.json runs concurrently: `npm run dev --prefix server` + `npm run dev --prefix client`. Client: Vite 5. Server: nodemon. No monorepo workspace links — each sub-package has its own node_modules.
test_framework: Vitest in server (no test files yet written for this feature set). No client test framework configured.
build_command: cd client && npm run build (for client-only build); npm run dev (root, for full dev stack)
test_command: cd server && npx vitest --run (no tests exist for these features; run build check instead: cd client && npm run build)
verification_instructions: 1. From repo root run `npm run dev` to start both processes. 2. Open http://localhost:5173. 3. Log in as demo1@taskforge.dev / Demo@1234. 4. Verify feature-specific behaviour as described in each FEAT's verification field. 5. For a build smoke-test run `cd client && npm run build` and confirm no Vite errors.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Paths use backslashes. Do NOT restart the server during verification if it is already running — the dev watcher reloads automatically on file save. The MongoDB Atlas URI is already in server/.env.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md present. Follow existing code style: ESM imports, no semicolons in JSX files, Tailwind utility classes, sonner toasts for all user-visible errors/successes.
key_patterns: API calls via client/src/api/*.js thin wrappers over axios instance in client/src/lib/axios.js. Server controllers use asyncHandler wrapper from utils/asyncHandler.js. Toast notifications via `import { toast } from 'sonner'`. Lucide React icons. react-hook-form + zod for forms. Confirmation modals: inline JSX overlay with `fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/40` (see ProjectsPage create-project dialog as canonical example). Skeleton loaders: `<div className='animate-pulse bg-gray-200 rounded …'>`. Project cards in ProjectsPage.jsx use a `<Link>` wrapper.
directory_structure:
taskforge/ (root, concurrently script + seed script)
  client/ — Vite+React app
    src/
      api/          — thin axios wrappers per resource
      components/   — Board.jsx, TaskDialog.jsx, Layout.jsx
      context/      — AuthContext.jsx
      lib/          — axios.js, utils.js
      pages/        — DashboardPage, ProjectsPage, ProjectDetailPage
  server/ — Express app
    src/
      controllers/  — projectController.js, taskController.js, …
      middleware/   — authMiddleware, errorHandler, projectAccess, validate
      models/       — Project.js, Task.js, User.js, Activity.js
      routes/       — projects.js, tasks.js, auth.js, …
      scripts/      — seed.js
      validators/   — projectValidator.js
    .env            — MONGO_URI, JWT_SECRET, etc.
